What We Do (And Do Not Do)

DealyVIP is a practical information and coordination platform for cross-border business. We maintain strict operational boundaries to ensure transparency and safety.

What DealyVIP Helps With

  • Information Orientation: Finding the right official verification resources for target countries.
  • Understanding Limitations: Clarifying the difference between a legal registry check and operational reality.
  • Visit Preparation: Helping you structure factory visits and business meetings.
  • Local Coordination: Where operationally available, coordinating independent local professionals (like interpreters or observation representatives) to act as your eyes and ears on the ground.

What DealyVIP Does NOT Do

  • We are not a Law Firm: We do not provide legal validation, contract review, or legal representation.
  • We are not a QA Agency: Observation visits are not certified technical inspections. We do not provide ISO certification or product safety guarantees.
  • We are not a Bank: We do not hold escrow, process cross-border payments, or guarantee financial security.
  • We are not an automated API: We do not possess a global database of companies. We route you to the relevant state-owned or official registries.

The Core Principle

INFORMATION ≠ GUARANTEE

REGISTRY CHECK ≠ FULL DUE DILIGENCE

LOCAL COORDINATION ≠ CERTIFIED INSPECTION
